q1_what_did_you_play: I played Powder Pop first to gain 1 Spark, then Firework Finale on Sludge Spinner, then Fwoosh! on Sludge Spinner, and finally Duck and Cover for 5 Block. This used the available Spark economy safely and produced the maximum printed damage available this turn while reducing the telegraphed 8 damage attack.
q2_other_line_considered: I considered playing the same damage cards without Duck and Cover, since the enemy is not killed and the turn could be played purely offensively. I rejected it because Duck and Cover costs only 1 energy, there is no other use for the remaining energy, and the 5 Block directly reduces the known incoming 8 damage.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 4 of the starting 5 Sparks after Powder Pop, leaving only 1 Spark, and it exhausted Firework Finale. It also spent 1 energy on Block rather than leaving that energy unused, though unused energy has no stated benefit this turn.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy had telegraphed a non-damaging intent, or an attack low enough that 5 Block would not matter, Duck and Cover would have been less attractive. If the enemy had telegraphed a much larger attack, Duck and Cover would have been even more clearly correct, but the rest of the line would likely remain the same.
